meeting.title: Weekly check-in
meeting.summary: Short status call. Warehouse service account is now provisioned and the project compiles clean in staging. Agreed to define the first batch of metrics next week and to book a working session to review naming conventions. One open item on the network policy change is with their platform team.
action_items: Send over the first-batch metric list for review
Book a working session to agree naming conventions
Chase the platform team on the network policy change
key_decisions: First metric batch scoped to the core fact table for next week
meeting.notes: Meeting was started ad hoc without a calendar invite. Speaker labels are unresolved. No customer named on the call — mostly a quick internal-feeling status sync.

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: Quick one today — mainly want to confirm the connection is stable before we start on metrics.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: It's stable. The service account got provisioned yesterday and the project compiled clean on the first try in staging.

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: That's the milestone I wanted. Next week let's define the first batch of metrics against the core fact table and then do a working session on naming.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: Works for me. One thing still open — the network policy change is sitting with our platform team, I'll chase it.

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: Great. I'll send the first-batch metric list over for you to review and we'll book the naming session. Short and sweet — thanks.
